book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: Fix pointed to something in front of the station.
A sledge.
A big sledge, with a sail, like a boat.
And its owner, a man named Mudge.

sentences.ar: بيقول: على التلج، بالريح، بتمشي أسرع من القطار.
sentences.en: He said: on the snow, with the wind, it goes faster than a train.

sentences.ar: لمحطة أوماها، ميتين ميل، بخمس ساعات.
sentences.en: To Omaha station, two hundred miles, in five hours.
And from Omaha, many trains to New York.
Fogg said: how much?
Mudge said: a hundred pounds.
Fogg said: let us go.
And the four got on, and wrapped themselves in furs.
And Mudge opened the sail.
And the wind caught the sail.
And the sledge flew.
Over the snow, at forty miles an hour.
The cold cutting their faces.
And Passepartout shouting for joy.
And Fix silent, his face blue.
And halfway, they heard howling.
Wolves.
A whole pack, running after them.
And gaining.

sentences.ar: ومادج قال: إذا وقفت الريح، أكلونا.
sentences.en: And Mudge said: if the wind drops, they eat us.
And Fogg took his pistol.
And Passepartout his guns.
But the wind did not drop.
And the wolves fell behind.
And after five hours, Omaha.
And the Chicago train waiting.

sentences.ar: وركبوا، وفوغ أعطى مادج مية جنيه.
sentences.en: And they boarded, and Fogg gave Mudge a hundred pounds.
And extra, for the wolves.
And Chicago, and then New York.

sentences.ar: ووصلوا نيويورك يوم 11 ديسمبر، الساعة 11:15 بالليل.
sentences.en: And they reached New York on 11 December, at 11:15 at night.
And ran to the harbour.
And the steamer, the China, had sailed at 11.
A quarter of an hour before.
